pattern: SELECT .* FROM (employee|hiring|evaluation) JOIN (employee|hiring|evaluation) ON \w+\.\w+ = \w+\.\w+ WHERE evaluation\.Year_awarded = \( SELECT MAX(Year_awarded) FROM evaluation \) GROUP BY employee\.Name ORDER BY SUM\(evaluation\.Bonus\) DESC LIMIT 1
correction: Remove unnecessary joins and avoid aggregating columns, order by the desired column directly, and remove grouping if not necessary.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that unnecessarily join multiple tables and suggests removing them to simplify the query.
